# Local QR encoder

`qrcode.mjs` is the unchanged ESM distribution from qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko
Arase, MIT (`LICENSE`), from https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/2.0.4 .
It renders the WhatsApp link into an inline SVG on the server. No QR image service,
remote script or browser JavaScript is used.
